backends.label: Desktop raylib
backends.surface: full raylib compatibility through Kryon wrapper symbols, including the 3D tier (camera, meshes, custom shaders, curated rlgl entry points) and the static-inline math3d surface

style_degradation.material: full: paints generated material layers, gradients, radius, blur, and glow through the raylib-backed renderer
style_degradation.effects: full: no style material/effect degradation expected
style_degradation.reporting: no degradation report is emitted for fully supported material/effect output

backends.label: Null headless
backends.surface: generated zero-return stubs plus Kryon input injection

style_degradation.material: headless no-op: style resolution preserves colors/material fields, but no pixels are painted
style_degradation.effects: unsupported: all material, gradient, radius, blur, and glow effects degrade to a no-op surface
style_degradation.reporting: manifest reports headless no-op degradation; tests assert resolved style data remains available before painting

backends.label: Web Canvas2D
backends.surface: Canvas2D and WebAudio implementation with null stubs for unsupported surface areas

style_degradation.material: partial: Canvas2D paints resolved colors and simple gradients; advanced material depth/glow degrades to flat Canvas2D fills
style_degradation.effects: partial: unsupported blur/glow material effects degrade without changing resolved colors or substituting another style pack
style_degradation.reporting: manifest reports Canvas2D material/effect degradation alongside canvas parity checks

backends.label: Web DOM
backends.surface: HTML/CSS DOM UI presentation with semantic page metadata, native heading/link/image annotations, CSS gradients, RGBA image-node textures, browser route helpers with route-change versioning, and null stubs for unsupported surface areas

style_degradation.material: partial: DOM/CSS applies resolved colors, radius, and CSS gradients; non-CSS material lighting degrades to ordinary CSS boxes
style_degradation.effects: partial: unsupported material depth/glow effects degrade to CSS-supported paint while keeping resolved style facts stable
style_degradation.reporting: manifest reports DOM material/effect degradation with semantic DOM smoke coverage

backends.label: Plan 9 libdraw
backends.surface: kry_sw software renderer presented through libdraw

style_degradation.material: software: kry_sw renders material layers before libdraw presentation, so style degradation is limited to presenter/platform constraints
style_degradation.effects: software: material effects follow kry_sw support; unsupported presenter features do not alter resolved colors
style_degradation.reporting: manifest reports libdraw as kry_sw-presented material output with matrix checks

backends.label: Terminal cells
backends.surface: terminal-cell drawing, raw terminal input, and null stubs for unsupported surface areas

style_degradation.material: terminal degradation: resolved foreground/background/focus colors map to terminal cells; radius, gradients, and material depth are ignored
style_degradation.effects: unsupported: blur/glow/shadow/material geometry degrade to terminal-cell color output without pack substitution
style_degradation.reporting: manifest reports terminal style degradation; termi checks cover the constrained backend smoke path
